Professional certifications such as CISSP, CEH, CCNA Security, SC-100, or SC-200, demonstrating advanced knowledge of security principles and practices. Strong technical expertise in Windows Server 2016/2019/2022, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Intune, Group Policy, PKI, Entra, and Azure SSO. Strong understanding of ITIL processes, security best practices, and risk management frameworks. Responsibilities Continuously evaluate and enhance the organization’s cybersecurity posture, ensuring compliance with industry standards and external security ratings. Identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities across hardware, software, and infrastructure components, with a focus on Windows Server and Azure cloud environments. Monitor emerging cyber threats and lead or support incident response investigations to mitigate risks and recover from security incidents effectively. Evaluate, test, and recommend security controls, threat prevention technologies, and security enhancements to strengthen the organization’s defenses. Develop and implement measures to prevent future security incidents by identifying and mitigating security risks and exposures. Lead efforts towards CE+ accreditation and support technical security, risk, and data protection initiatives from a practical, operational perspective. review_candidates.description: The position is described below. If you want to apply, click the Apply Now button at the top or bottom of this page. After you click Apply Now and complete your application, you'll be invited to create a profile, which will let you see your application status and any communications. If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status. Need Help? If you have a disability and need assistance with the application, you can request a reasonable accommodation. Send an email to Accessibility (accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response). Regular or Temporary: Regular Language Fluency: English (Required) Work Shift: 1st shift (United States of America) Please review the following job description: The Senior Network Automation and Tool Integration Engineer designs and delivers secure, end-to-end automation across enterprise network, observability, IT service management, and DevOps platforms. This role connects existing workflows in Python and Ansible automation with GitLab Duo, Ansible Automation Platform, Cisco SD-WAN controllers, Catalyst Center, Splunk Cloud, OpenText NNMi, ServiceNow, and ThousandEyes. The engineer develops reusable Python services, REST API integrations, Ansible workflows, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines that convert manual processes and standalone scripts into scalable, governed automation services. Responsibilities include automated provisioning, configuration validation, incident enrichment, compliance checks, event correlation, change execution, post-change validation, and closed-loop remediation. The ideal candidate has strong Python, API, Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, and enterprise integration experience, combined with practical knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, telemetry, and network operations. The candidate should also be able to containerize Python APIs and lightweight front-end applications and deploy them to an enterprise container platform or UI for simple user experience. This role collaborates with network engineering, operations, platform, cybersecurity, and ITSM teams to establish reusable integration patterns, improve operational efficiency, strengthen automation governance, and deliver observable, auditable, production-ready solutions. For this opportunity: Truist will not sponsor an applicant for work visa status or employment authorization, nor will we offer any immigration-related support for this position (including, but not limited to H-1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN-1 or TN-2, E-3, O-1, or future sponsorship for U.S. lawful permanent residence status.) *** Role is NOT remote *** *** In office expectations are 5 days per week. *** Essential Duties And Responsibilities Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. Designs, builds, and implements enterprise infrastructure technology platforms and systems across cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, or middleware domains. Applies automation, monitoring, and optimization techniques to ensure high availability and performance of infrastructure. Manages infrastructure engineering projects and processes aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to integrate new technologies and continuously improve infrastructure standards and processes. Troubleshoots and resolves complex technical issues impacting infrastructure performance and reliability. Supports compliance with technology strategies, standards, and governance to mitigate risks and ensure regulatory adherence. Reviews and guides infrastructure designs, configurations, and procedures to support operational consistency and knowledge sharing. Provides technical guidance and direction to lower-level technical professionals. Develops technical solutions with deep analysis of infrastructure systems and leads infrastructure processes. Qualifications Required Qualifications The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering. Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies including cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, and middleware. Preferred Qualifications Strong knowledge and experience in software development and technical designs and implementation. Proven experience managing IT infrastructure projects. Proficiency in GitLab CI/CD pipeline authoring, including multi-stage pipelines, runners, environments, and security scanning integration. Working knowledge of Ansible , SON, YAML and Ansible Automation Platform, including playbook authoring, inventory management, and AAP workflow templates. Experience with OPA (Open Policy Agent) and policy-as-code patterns in pipeline enforcement contexts. Infrastructure-as-code competency in Terraform or equivalent, with demonstrated deployment experience in Azure and/or AWS environments, Hosted appsv. Python/Flask and/or scripting proficiency sufficient to build integration glue, automate workflows, and produce production-grade tooling in short iteration cycles. Experience working in a regulated financial services, healthcare, or government environment where compliance constraints directly shape technical architecture decisions. Operates with high ownership and can make meaningful progress without fully defined requirements. Communicates technical complexity in plain language and can effectively engage both executive and technical audiences. Comfortable operating in environments that include legacy technologies, ongoing modernization efforts, and emerging capabilities. Expertise and Skills in Areas Mentioned Below: APIs - REST, Webhooks ITSM - ServiceNow APIs Observability - Splunk, ThousandEyes, SNMP traps Networking - Catalyst Center APIs, vManage APIs, Meraki Integration - Event-driven architecture General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation: All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site. Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non-temporary position for which you apply, based on full-time or part-time status, position, and division of work. review_candidates.title: ERP System Administrator (Deltek Vantagepoint)
review_candidates.description: Ardurra is looking to hire an ERP System Administrator (Deltek Vantagepoint) to join our Information Technology team. This position is open to remote or hybrid applicants. Ardurra is a multidisciplinary civil engineering services firm which provides broad-based solutions tailored to the specific needs of the public and private sector. We leverage the depth of our professional and technical expertise, as well as our integrated structure, to deliver practical, innovative solutions for our clients. We have been creating opportunities for our employees to develop both personally and professionally. As a result, our team has contributed to some of the nation’s most important infrastructure projects. These are projects that can positively impact people’s lives. Position Summary The ERP System Administrator is responsible for managing, supporting, and optimizing the company's ERP system. This role involves maintaining the Deltek Vantagepoint system, troubleshooting issues, providing user support, and implementing system upgrades and enhancements. The ERP System Administrator will work closely with the shared services teams and other stakeholders to ensure the system meets organizational needs and drives efficiency. Key Responsibilities System Administration: Manage and maintain the company’s ERP System (Deltek Vantagepoint) ensuring optimal performance and availability. User Support: Provide technical support and training to end-users, addressing queries and resolving system-related issues promptly. Data Management: Oversee data integrity and accuracy, ensuring proper data flow and consistency. Data Migration: Assist and support in the migration of acquisition data. System Enhancements: Collaborate with stakeholders to identify system enhancement opportunities and assist in the implementation of new features and tools. Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve system issues, working with technical teams as necessary to ensure minimal disruption to operations. Documentation: Create and maintain documentation for system processes, user guides, and troubleshooting procedures to support end-users effectively. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Minimum 3 years of experience with Deltek Vantagepoint or Deltek Vision. Advanced expertise of accounting processes and procedures. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with various levels of the organization. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. Preferred Qualifications Expertise in Microsoft SQL Server (queries, stored procedures, performance tuning). Familiarity with financial reporting tools and methodologies, or Corporate Accounting processes in a professional services environment. Background in professional services, architecture/engineering, or construction industries. Competencies Accountability Adaptability Communication Planning & Organization Personal Development Why Ardurra? While Ardurra offers competitive compensation and rich benefits programs, it is our culture that truly sets us apart from our peers. We nurture a family-like culture, striving to create a work environment that is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding but also fun. We are acutely focused on developing our staff, whether through our internal Ardurra Academy or through our industry-leading Leadership program. We have made a deliberate and focused commitment to nurture a people-centric culture where people are: valued as individuals; supported in their professional and career development with multiple, varied career paths; provided the tools and resources to be successful, engaged, and satisfied in their work; and positive benefits, time-off programs, and flexibility to help maintain a healthy balance between work and home. Ardurra is an Equal Opportunity/ Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation. Notice To Third Party Agencies Ardurra does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Agency Agreement, Ardurra will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. If a resume or candidate is submitted to any hiring manager without a previously signed agreement, Ardurra reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. These candidates will be considered property of Ardurra. We’re not currently looking to add any more agencies to our list of approved vendors, so please do not contact any of our managers or recruitment team with sales calls or details of your candidates. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor. Finance Accounting

review_candidates.title: Cloud and Infrastructure Security Technician
review_candidates.description: Description Classification: Exempt Compensation Range: $75k-$85k Location: Austin, TX Work Type: Hybrid Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm CT Reports To: Head of Technology Company Description For years, most people didn’t understand risk, insurance, or the policies themselves. Yet, back in 1969, a small group of Texas independent agents knew the truth: with a structured curriculum and practical, real-life education beyond theory, they could ignite an entire industry of skilled professionals. Together with University of Texas educators, these pioneering agents formed the industry’s first nonprofit training and CE credit resource. Along the way, we’ve built a genuine community of professionals who succeed and thrive. For decades, we’ve impacted millions of professionals with our practical education. Like us, they’re dedicated to lifelong learning and collaboration. Our participants understand their career potential and gain a real workplace advantage. Today, our education and networks continue to evolve and expand. We are trusted to lead the risk management and insurance industry through change. The Risk & Insurance Education Alliance ensures no one must go it alone. We’ve made success a group activity. Mission We are committed to creating professionals through practical education and technical guidance to lead the risk management and insurance industry of the future, for the common good. Vision Empowering a confident, professional community to shape tomorrow's risk and insurance industry. Core Values The educational programs and research conducted by The Risk & Insurance Education Alliance were built on a foundation of Innovation , Imagination, Integrity, and Inspiration . These qualities commit us to act responsibly, to be accountable for our actions, to fulfil our obligations, and to inspire others with our relentless determination to achieve a standard of excellence in every endeavor. Our Benefits 17 Paid Holidays- Closed the week between Christmas Eve and New Years Day Medical, Dental Vision, & Supplemental Insurance Flexible Spending Account & Health Savings Account Employee Assistance Program Company Paid Long Term Disability Company Paid Life Insurance Vacation, Sick, Birthday, & Volunteering Paid Time Off 401K- 4.5% Match Paid Parental Leave Employee Referral Program Book Club Company Happy Hours Position Description The Cloud and Cybersecurity Technician is a senior technical role responsible for safeguarding the organization's cloud environments, digital assets, and information systems through the implementation of security controls, monitoring, risk management, and compliance initiatives. The role serves as a primary contributor to cloud security architecture, cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, threat detection and response, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance efforts, while partnering with IT and business stakeholders to support secure technology adoption across the organization. This position plays a key role in executing cybersecurity strategy, strengthening the organization's security posture, responding to incidents, and advancing cloud security and governance initiatives. While the role does not define enterprise technology strategy, it is responsible for implementing and maintaining approved security architectures, controls, policies, and operational practices that protect organizational systems, data, and services. The Cloud and Cybersecurity Technician also provides technical leadership in security-focused projects, continuous monitoring, risk remediation, and compliance validation to ensure a resilient and secure technology environment. Requirements Responsibilities: Security & Compliance (Execution & Operations) Support execution of the organization’s security framework through tooling, configuration, and operational follow-through. Perform alert monitoring and initial incident triage, escalating to leadership or vendors as appropriate. Maintain operational ownership of incident response, including coordination, remediation execution, and documentation. Assist with vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation efforts across infrastructure, platforms, and vendors. Support user security awareness and risk training initiatives developed by leadership. Assist with audit preparation and compliance validation, including evidence collection and remediation tracking. Vendor & Project Coordination Coordinate with external vendors and managed service providers to support infrastructure, security, and platform operations. Escalate incidents and technical issues to vendors as required and track resolution through closure. Support technology projects by executing technical tasks, validating changes, and ensuring operational readiness. Participate in change management workflows, ensuring infrastructure and security changes follow approved processes. IT Operations & Cross-Role Support Provide Tier 2–3 technical support for infrastructure, network, and platform-level issues. Assist the Senior Systems Administrator and/or Systems Support/Helpdesk (L1) role during periods of increased demand or complex operational work. Support onboarding and offboarding workflows as needed to ensure access, systems, and infrastructure readiness. Participate in requirements gathering and customer-facing analysis for infrastructure and platform initiatives. Quality, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Perform structured QA and regression testing for infrastructure, network, and platform changes. review_candidates.title: Staff IT Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Abridge Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients. Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. The Role As a Staff IT Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for driving efficiency and scale across the entire corporate IT infrastructure and enterprise ecosystem. You will design, build, and maintain mission-critical automation solutions that eliminate manual processes, enhance security posture, and improve the employee experience globally. This role requires deep engineering expertise, an IT product mindset for automation, and the ability to mentor junior team members while tackling the organization's most complex integration and scaling challenges. You will work directly with IT leadership, Security leadership, and department heads across the company. Operating at the intersection of healthcare AI and enterprise IT, you will be expected to architect and enforce automation standards that meet the rigorous demands of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-audited environment. What You'll Do Workflow Automation: Develop scalable, resilient workflow automation solutions to streamline critical business processes, including onboarding/offboarding, access requests, compliance enforcement, and self-service IT support. API and Integration Development: Serve as the subject matter expert for integrating disparate systems by building robust, fault-tolerant connections using APIs and event-driven architectures. Identity and Access Management (IAM): Drive automation within the IAM infrastructure, focusing on automated role assignment, least-privilege policy enforcement, and audit-friendly logging of authentication and authorization events. Enterprise Data Engineering: Architect and engineer robust data platforms for IT, ensuring efficient collection, normalization, and secure storage of high-volume enterprise data for reporting, audit, and advanced analytics. Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier for the team — establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, documenting architectures, and mentoring engineers in automation principles. Business Systems & Custom Application Deployment: Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of business-critical systems and custom-built applications, from architecture and vendor evaluation through implementation, integration, and ongoing support — ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise IT standards. What You'll Need Experience: 10+ years in IT Engineering, IT Apps Development, or DevOps, with at least 5 years dedicated to large-scale enterprise automation. Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience automating complex operations and governance across GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. You will bring an ability to build and modularize infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (i.e. Terraform). Programming Proficiency: Highly proficient in at least one modern programming language; strong preference for Python. Systems Integration: Proven experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and querying and managing relational databases (SQL strongly preferred). Automation Platforms: Extensive experience designing and managing centralized automation platforms (e.g., n8n, SOAR, Ansible, Workato, or custom frameworks). Compliance Context: Experience operating in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with exposure to SOC 2, HIPAA, or equivalent compliance frameworks. Communication: Able to communicate effectively across a wide range of audiences — from engineers to GTM stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives. Bonus Points Experience with agentic AI or ML models applied to IT automation (proactive issue detection, intelligent routing, NLP). Why Work at Abridge? At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month. Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business. Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you. How we take care of Abridgers: Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families. Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA. Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees. Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family. 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future. Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage. Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits. Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more. Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals. Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment. Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees. ... and much more! Equal Opportunity Employer Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process. Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions. Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

review_candidates.title: Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Everforth ECS is seeking a Cloud Engineer to work in our Quantico, VA office. ECS is seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer (Mid) to support cutting-edge technology for law enforcement and scientific organizations. The Cloud Engineer will be responsible for the design, deployment, configuration, security, monitoring, and maintenance of AWS cloud infrastructure and cloud-native services supporting mission-critical applications and data systems. We are seeking a creative problem solver who enjoys tackling complex cloud engineering challenges with minimal oversight, enabling scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments. The ideal candidate has strong AWS experience and a deep understanding of cloud architecture principles, security best practices, automation, and operational excellence. A strong desire and aptitude for learning is required, along with the ability to adapt and drive change in an environment with evolving requirements, technologies, and security threats. This individual will be integral to supporting secure data operations, system reliability, and infrastructure modernization efforts across diverse client environments. Responsibilities of the Cloud Engineer include but are not limited to: Design, deploy, configure, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as CloudFormation or Terraform. Architect and support highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable AWS environments aligned with AWS Well-Architected Framework best practices. Configure and manage core AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudWatch, and related services. Support multi-environment (Dev, Test, Prod) cloud deployments while ensuring configuration consistency and security compliance. Implement and manage networking components including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, NAT gateways, and load balancers. Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and cost utilization using CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config, and related tools. Support patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management of cloud-hosted systems and operating systems (Linux-based preferred). Implement security best practices including least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and logging/auditing controls. Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues in AWS environments. Collaborate with DevOps, security, engineering, and data teams to support application deployment and operational stability. Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements for infrastructure reliability, cost optimization, and security posture. Salary Range: $150,000 - $180,000 General Description Of Benefits Required Skills US Citizenship and active Top-Secret Clearance. 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure. Strong experience with AWS core services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail. 5+ years of experience using Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation or Terraform). Strong understanding of AWS networking (VPC architecture, subnets, routing, security groups, NACLs, NAT gateways). 5+ years of Linux system administration experience; comfort navigating and troubleshooting Linux environments. Experience implementing cloud security best practices, including IAM policies, encryption (KMS), logging, and compliance controls. Experience with automation and scripting (Bash, Python). Experience supporting large, complex systems and data sets in cloud environments. Desired Skills Experience operating within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and Kanban Familiarity with ITIL and NIST configuration management frameworks and best practices Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Experience creating custom workflows, dashboards, and reporting metrics in Jira Experience delivering excellence in Federal Government (preferably the Department of Justice) cybersecurity and working within DOJ FBI, practices, standards, processes and policies. Interest in new technologies and the ability to adapt to those new technologies. ECS Federal LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis any characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local jurisdiction law. Everforth ECS is the federal segment of Everforth , a $4B global organization with over 10,000 employees. Our nearly 3,500 professionals deliver advanced technology solutions in data and AI, cybersecurity, and enterprise transformation, serving defense, intelligence, and federal civilian agencies. Our work powers mission-critical outcomes, strengthens technology partnerships, and creates meaningful opportunities for our people. We are defined by a commitment to excellence in delivery, a culture of innovation, and an environment where talent can thrive and grow. We Value Attracting and developing top talent and high-performing teams Fostering a culture that is engaging, accountable, and mission-driven Meet the challenge. Make a difference with Everforth ECS!

review_candidates.title: Security Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Role As a Security Engineer at K Health, you will serve as a foundational force in securing our healthcare technology ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Director of Security, this is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role focused primarily on Security Operations (SecOps) and IT Security projects. You will be responsible for building, automating, and maintaining our security controls while acting as a key responder to security incidents. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you are empowered to own your domain, automate repetitive tasks, and directly safeguard patient and organizational data, this role is for you. What You Will Do Design, implement, and maintain hands-on SecOps workflows, threat detection, and incident response procedures across our corporate and cloud infrastructure. Build low-code and custom automations (using tools like Torq) to streamline security alerts, routine IT security tasks, and incident triage. Administer, optimize, and manage key security and endpoint management tools, including Sumo Logic, Jamf, Intune, Slack Enterprise, CrowdStrike, and related platforms. Maintain and support continuous compliance with SOC2 and HIPAA security controls, actively participating in audit preparation, evidence gathering, and control enforcement. Partner with cross-functional IT and engineering teams to harden systems, enforce zero-trust endpoint policies, and secure employee workflows. Conduct root-cause analysis on security incidents and proactively implement preventative security measures to eliminate recurring risks. What We Are Looking For Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated hands-on experience in Security Operations, IT Security, or System Administration with a strong security focus. Incident Response: Proven background in actively detecting, investigating, and remediating security incidents in a modern cloud/hybrid environment. Technical Depth: Deep foundational IT background spanning endpoint administration (macOS/Windows), identity management, and network security. Compliance Standards: Demonstrated experience maintaining controls for SOC2 and/or HIPAA frameworks in an operational setting. Automation Mindset: Hands-on experience automating security operations or IT tasks using SOAR platforms, scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash), or API integrations. Bonus Direct experience implementing SOC2 or HIPAA controls from scratch or directly interfacing with external auditors. Hands-on familiarity with our specific technology stack: Sumo Logic, Jamf, Intune, Slack Enterprise, CrowdStrike, and Torq. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Security+, Network+, GIAC, or vendor-specific platform certifications). Benefits & Perks Hybrid work schedule with weekly lunches and stocked fridges Monthly social committees for company events 18 vacation days, 9 company holidays, 5 sick days, and 2 personal days Stock options for every full-time employee Paid parental leave 401k benefit Commuter Benefits Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options Compensation $125,000 - $150,000 USD Who We Are Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine. Esteemed health systems like Mayo Clinic, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Hackensack Meridian Health, and Hartford Healthcare partner with K Health to build and run modern primary virtual care clinics on their behalf. Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability. review_candidates.title: Ingénieur d’Exploitation & DevOps (H/F) – CDI – Tours (37)
review_candidates.description: Depuis plus de 25 ans, Primpromo s'est imposé comme un SaaS incontournable dans le domaine de la promotion immobilière. La solution équipe d'ailleurs 9 Grands Comptes sur 10 en France, et s'étend au-delà des frontières nationales. Développée en collaboration avec la plupart des grands acteurs nationaux du marché, Primpromo couvre l'ensemble des processus liés à l'activité de promotion immobilière (gestion budgétaire, gestion juridique & comptable, gestion commerciale & ADV...). L'équipe souhaite rencontrer son/sa futur(e) collègue pour intégrer le pôle Expert Technique, basé dans nos locaux de Tours. Ce Qui Vous Attend Dans un contexte de transformation des infrastructures vers le cloud Azure et l’adoption de pratiques DevOps, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur d’Exploitation & DevOps. Vous interviendrez au sein d’un pôle d’expertise technique composé de spécialistes (API, Data, Apps, Cloud/Infra, DevOps), dans un environnement en pleine modernisation, avec de nombreux projets de migration et d’automatisation. En tant qu'Ingénieur d’Exploitation & DevOps (H/F), vos missions au quotidien seront : Exploitation / Run Administration et maintien en conditions opérationnelles d’environnements (ERP et applications). Installation, patching et configuration des systèmes. Gestion des utilisateurs et des accès. Analyse d’exploitation et support N1/N2. Suivi des incidents et résolution. Gestion de fichiers de configuration. Rédaction et mise à jour de procédures techniques et documentations utilisateurs. Supervision & monitoring Suivi des applications et des infrastructures. Utilisation d’outils de supervision (Application Manager, Grafana, outils de monitoring). Analyse des alertes et amélioration continue de la supervision. Contribution DevOps & Automatisation Participation active aux initiatives de migration vers Azure. Automatisation des tâches d’exploitation (une maîtrise ou appétence pour Python est un plus). Contribution et optimisation des pipelines CI/CD. Mise en place des pratiques DevOps. Participation à l’industrialisation des déploiements et des environnements. Note : Missions en HNO possibles / Possibles astreintes à terme. Vous Êtes Fait(e) Pour Ce Poste Idéalement issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en Informatique ou professionnel(le) expérimenté(e), vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie en exploitation applicative, intégration logicielle ou administration système. Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise de Linux et SQL (indispensable). Expérience ou compréhension des environnements d’exploitation (Run, support technique N1/N2). Appétence pour l'écosystème DevOps & Cloud : Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab. Soft Skills Polyvalent(e), avec la capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets différents en parallèle. Autonome et rigoureux(se) (fiabilité indispensable dans l’exploitation). Curieux(se), avec une réelle volonté d’apporter des solutions modernes à notre infrastructure. Sens du service, bon relationnel et esprit d’équipe. Que vous soyez un(e) professionnel(le) expérimenté(e) souhaitant mettre à profit son expertise Azure pour piloter cette transition, ou un profil plus junior à fort potentiel prêt à s'investir, votre autonomie et votre rigueur feront la différence. Un plus apprécié ? La connaissance du secteur de l'Immobilier. Si vous souhaitez rejoindre une structure à taille humaine, travailler sur un produit leader de son marché et évoluer au sein d'un environnement technologique en pleine mutation, ce poste est fait pour vous. Intéressé(e) ? Postulez directement en commentaire ou par message privé. #DevOps #Azure #Linux #Tours #CDI #Cloud

review_candidates.description: Requisition ID: 298738 Relocation Authorized: National - Family Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project Work Location: New Albany, OH Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations. Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report. Project Overview Bechtel is building a semiconductor manufacturing plant in New Albany, Ohio. We are partnering with the North America Building Trades Unions and suppliers to create several thousand new jobs and work with local education organizations to implement new training programs that will support the future talent pipeline. Bechtel Manufacturing & Technology, Inc. offers engineering, procurement, and construction services for customers in the semiconductor manufacturing, electric vehicle, and data center markets. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, the M&T global business unit also includes colleagues working in Arizona, Ohio, Texas, India, and additional project locations around the world. M&T strives to exceed our customer objectives through utilizing our agility, innovative technologies, and world class talent. M&T will solve the industries toughest challenges, building both our company and the world for the future. Job Summary The Life Safety Systems (LSS) CSU Engineer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing commissioning, startup, testing, and turnover activities associated with Life Safety Systems throughout a large semiconductor manufacturing facility. The position is part of the Commissioning and Startup (CSU) organization and works for the EPC contractor responsible for delivering the facility from construction completion through operational readiness. The LSS CSU Engineer will lead commissioning activities for fire detection, fire alarm, fire suppression, emergency communications, hazardous gas detection, smoke control, emergency power interfaces, and other life safety systems. The role requires close coordination with engineering, construction, vendors, authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), client operations personnel, and other CSU disciplines to ensure systems are tested, integrated, documented, and turned over safely and in accordance with project requirements. The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise, a commitment to safety, excellent communication skills, and the ability to troubleshoot complex integrated life safety systems within a mission critical environment. Collaborate: Actively seeks out others’ opinions and input and is open-minded to their views. Challenges others appropriately and is also open to being challenged on their own views. Communicate: Is effective at adapting their communication style appropriately to their audience, providing context and using the right tone and level of information. Customer Focus: Prioritizes the customer needs and puts these at the forefront of all interactions. Ensures that others within their team maintain this same approach. Deliver: Demonstrates making well thought out, timely decisions and prioritization that leads to successful outcomes. Includes the right people at the right time. Problem Solve: Accurately assesses a situation to find the best solution or way of working to resolve the issues. It is focused on creating a long term fix rather than a short-term solution. Role Model: Contributes to the Bechtel culture by inspiring and motivating others through their positive approach and attitude. Comes to work determined to do a good job, for themselves and for their team. Adaptability: Deep understanding of interconnected technology systems and how to troubleshoot them while they are actively running. Compliance: Ensure all procedures and equipment setups meet regulatory, OSHA, and environmental safety standards. Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Resolve complex failures involving computer hardware, network routers, switches, and software interfacing directly with control equipment. Major Responsibilities Planning and Commissioning Execution Develop and execute commissioning and startup plans for Life Safety Systems. Prepare commissioning procedures, test scripts, integrated testing plans, and acceptance criteria. Review project specifications, drawings, cause-and-effect matrices, sequence of operations, and vendor documentation. Support constructability, operability, maintainability, and commissioning reviews during project execution. Plan and coordinate system walkdowns, punch list development, and turnover activities. Testing and Verification Lead functional and integrated testing of Life Safety Systems, including: Fire Alarm Systems Fire Detection Systems Clean Agent Suppression Systems Wet and Dry Sprinkler Systems Pre-Action Systems Emergency Voice/Communication Systems Gas Detection Systems Smoke Control and Purge Systems Emergency Shutdown Interfaces Emergency Power and Backup Power Interfaces Building Automation System (BAS) and Integrated Control System Interfaces Witness and document Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) and Site Acceptance Tests (SATs). Verify system performance against project requirements, code requirements, and client standards. Support integrated facility testing involving multiple disciplines and systems. Major Responsibility (Cont.) 1 System Integration and Troubleshooting Coordinate with Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Controls, Automation, Process Systems, and Construction teams. Investigate and resolve commissioning deficiencies and technical issues. Support root cause analysis and corrective action development. Verify proper interaction and functionality between life safety systems and facility control platforms. Compliance and Safety Ensure commissioning activities comply with: NFPA Codes and Standards International Building Code (IBC) International Fire Code (IFC) Applicable OSHA Requirements Local AHJ Requirements Project Specifications Client Standards Support permit-to-work, lockout/tagout, energization, and hazard control processes. Promote and maintain a strong safety culture throughout all startup and commissioning activities. Documentation and Turnover Manage commissioning documentation through approved digital completions systems. Track commissioning progress, system status, punch items, and readiness metrics. Prepare turnover packages and support handover to operations. Verify completion of required as-built documentation, operating procedures, and maintenance documentation. Stakeholder Coordination Major Responsibility (Cont.) 2 Coordinate activities with: Engineering Teams Construction Teams Equipment Vendors Client Representatives Facilities Operations Personnel Local Authorities and AHJs Participate in startup planning meetings and readiness reviews. Provide regular updates regarding commissioning progress, risks, and mitigation plans. Education And Experience Requirements Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related discipline and 5-8 years of relevant experience in mission critical facilities or 9-12 years of relevant work experience in mission critical facilities. Required Knowledge And Skills Extensive knowledge of: Fire Alarm Systems Fire Suppression Systems Hazardous Gas Monitoring Systems Smoke Management Systems Emergency Communications Systems Life Safety Codes and Standards Strong understanding of control system integration and sequence testing. Ability to read and interpret: P&IDs One-line Diagrams Control Schematics Cause-and-Effect Matrices Network Architecture Drawings Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced construction environment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and commissioning management software. Total Rewards/Benefits For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent. We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy. Bechtel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status (except as authorized by law), protected veteran status, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Applicants with a disability, who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, may e-mail their request to acesstmt@bechtel.com

review_candidates.title: Office Management/Staff Officer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Everforth ECS is seeking an Office Manager/Staff Officer, Mid-Level to work at our Chantilly, VA customer site. Note: This position is contingent upon contract award and final acceptance by government customer. Office Management/Staff Officer Work Role The Office Management/Staff Officer role is responsible for the full spectrum of administrative, communication, and operational support within the organization. This role includes direct support to senior leadership by managing daily operations and schedules, deconflicting calendars, and arranging travel through government systems such as the Defense Travel System (DTS) and the Management and Execution Tracker (MET). Another key function is the rigorous management of all internal and external taskers through NGA’s NCERTS system to ensure timely coordination and completion. The role is central to office communications, involving the development, editing, and distribution of finished materials such as briefings, reports, meeting minutes, and strategic messaging. Office Management/Staff Officers manage records and information management, including SharePoint site administration, and coordinate all aspects of meeting and event planning, making the position integral to the office's efficient functioning. This role manages day-to-day activities so leadership can focus on strategic planning and execution. Duties May Include Administrative & Office Support: Perform a full range of administrative duties, including managing calendars, scheduling, and coordinating meetings, reserving conference rooms, reserving conference rooms, setting up Video Teleconference (VTC) or online meeting connections, and anticipating and preparing materials needed for conferences, Town Halls, Offsites, appointments, and briefings. Task & Correspondence Management: Serve as a suspense coordinator for the office, using systems like N-CERTS to receive, track, coordinate, and respond to internal and external taskers. Draft and edit routine correspondence, reports, and staff summaries to ensure they are accurate and adhere to agency standards. Communications & Reporting: Draft, review, and edit official correspondence, memoranda, weekly activity reports, briefings, and meeting minutes. Prepare special or one-time reports and summaries by selecting and synthesizing relevant information from various sources. Articulate and exchange information (i.e., requirements, actions, needs, status, etc.) in a professional tone and attitude to achieve efficient business rhythms. Meeting & Event Coordination: Coordinate and support office staff meetings, governance forums, and other events. This includes preparing agendas, distributing read-ahead materials, preparing and distributing meeting minutes, and tracking action items to closure. Travel Coordination: Assist with travel arrangements by preparing travel orders and vouchers in the Defense Travel System (DTS) and creating requests in the Management and Execution Tracker (MET). Assist with conference planning. Coordinate logistics for office moves, update seating charts, initiate equipment trouble tickets, and manage office supplies by serving as the POC for inventory and coordinating the purchase list. Information Management: Manage office records and files in compliance with agency policy. Maintain and update SharePoint sites, distribution lists, organizational charts, and recall rosters. Work closely with the Primary Information Officer and the designated Information Officer within the Directorate’s Front Office in their assigned duties. Maintain security groups, distribution groups, and folder permissions to ensure access to and security of files. Logistical Support: Manage office logistics, including inventorying and purchasing office supplies, coordinating office moves, updating seating charts, and initiating equipment trouble tickets. Process Improvement: Identify administrative issues and assist in the analysis and development of improved business processes, checklists, or Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Assist in the development, maintenance, and/or improvement of Directorate business operations policies. Other duties, as assigned. Salary Range: $95,000-116,000 Benefits General Description of Benefits Required Skills U.S. Citizenship A minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in a Business, Management, or related field. In lieu of a degree, 10+ years of directly applicable experience is required Active TS/SCI with ability to pass CI Poly A minimum of 7+ years of relevant office management or administrative experience Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate solution Highly developed interpersonal and oral/written communication skills, with the ability to effectively and professionally interact with a diverse set of stakeholders (from peers to end-users to executive management) Core Skills - Demonstrated interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to synthesize information and prepare clear, concise materials High level of attention to detail and the ability to prioritize a dynamic workload with competing deadlines Experience interacting professionally with staff at all levels, including senior leaders and external partners Proven ability to work independently on assigned tasks and as part of a collaborative team Ability to analyze information and make recommendations to address the functional needs of the organization Technical Skills - Extensive knowledge and demonstrated skill with the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) Experience using and administering SharePoint sites Demonstrated knowledge of office information technology (IT) equipment (e.g., copiers, scanners, facsimile machines, computer workstations, phones, teleconference/video teleconference equipment) with the ability to independently operate such equipment in completing administrative tasks Desired Skills Active TS/SCI w/CI Poly Proficiency with government systems is highly desired, including the NGA Central Electronic Routing and Tasking System (N-CERTS), and the Management and Execution Tracker (MET) Experience using Defense Travel System (DTS) Working knowledge of the Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS) and PeopleSoft ECS Federal LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis any characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local jurisdiction law. Everforth ECS is the federal segment of Everforth , a $4B global organization with over 10,000 employees. Our nearly 3,500 professionals deliver advanced technology solutions in data and AI, cybersecurity, and enterprise transformation, serving defense, intelligence, and federal civilian agencies. Our work powers mission-critical outcomes, strengthens technology partnerships, and creates meaningful opportunities for our people. We are defined by a commitment to excellence in delivery, a culture of innovation, and an environment where talent can thrive and grow. We Value Attracting and developing top talent and high-performing teams Fostering a culture that is engaging, accountable, and mission-driven Meet the challenge. Make a difference with Everforth ECS!

This position requires a technically proficient, customer-focused professional capable of troubleshooting complex AV/VTC issues, supporting conference and collaboration environments, maintaining associated hardware and software, and coordinating with technical teams to ensure reliable service delivery. The position is contractually aligned to the HW/SW Specialist LCAT . Essential Duties And Responsibilities Install, configure, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot AV/VTC hardware and software systems. Provide technical support for video conferencing, audio conferencing, presentation, display, and collaboration technologies. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, connectivity, peripheral, and AV/VTC system issues. Support conference rooms and other customer-facing AV/VTC environments, including setup, testing, operation, and troubleshooting. Perform pre-event system checks and provide real-time technical support for meetings, conferences, and other mission-critical events. Install and replace AV/VTC components, displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, codecs, cabling, control devices, and related equipment as authorized. Troubleshoot Windows-based workstations and other hardware/software components associated with AV/VTC environments. Perform preventive maintenance and routine system inspections to identify potential failures before they affect operations. Coordinate with network, systems, help desk, configuration management, and other technical personnel to resolve issues that cross functional boundaries. Document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting actions, equipment changes, and resolutions in accordance with program procedures. Maintain accurate hardware/software and configuration information as required. Assist with equipment inventories, technology refreshes, installations, upgrades, and system replacements. Escalate complex technical issues and recurring system problems through established support channels. Follow applicable DoD, JSP, cybersecurity, configuration management, and change-control requirements. Maintain a high level of professionalism when supporting senior government personnel and other mission customers. Perform other AV/VTC and hardware/software support duties within the scope of the assigned LCAT. Hands-on experience troubleshooting hardware and software in an enterprise IT environment. Experience supporting video conferencing and conference-room technologies. Working knowledge of computers, displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, cabling, peripheral devices, and related AV/VTC components. Ability to isolate technical problems and determine whether issues originate with hardware, software, network connectivity, configuration, or peripheral equipment. Strong customer-service and communication skills. Ability to document technical issues and resolutions clearly and accurately. review_candidates.title: Lead Engineer -DevOps
review_candidates.description: Overview Lead Engineer – DevOps Location : Dallas, NYC, NJ Role Type : Hybrid Role Role Overview We are looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer to drive the design, automation, and reliability of our modern data and analytics platform at Catalyst Brands. This role will focus on building and managing scalable, secure, and high-performing infrastructure across a growing and evolving ecosystem of data and analytics technologies. While current platforms include MicroStrategy, Snowflake, AWS, Airflow, and Tableau, this role requires a proactive, adaptable engineer who can continuously learn, evaluate, and integrate new tools as business needs evolve. You will work at the intersection of platform engineering and data operations, enabling seamless deployment, monitoring, and governance of data and analytics solutions. This role combines hands-on platform engineering expertise with platform ownership and cross-functional collaboration, partnering with data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver resilient and efficient systems. Responsibilities Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure and platform services across AWS, Datameer, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Snowflake, Airflow etc. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data and analytics applications, ensuring reliable and automated deployments. Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation. Ensure platform reliability through monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response practices. Optimize performance, scalability, and cost across cloud environments and analytics platforms. Implement security best practices, including identity management, data protection, and compliance controls. Collaborate with data engineering, analytics and cross-functional teams to enable efficient data workflows and platform usage. Automate operational processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention. Support environment provisioning, configuration management, and release management processes. Continuously evaluate, adopt, and integrate new platforms and tools as the data ecosystem evolves. Lead platform standardization while remaining adaptable to emerging technologies and changing business needs. Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to modernize or replace existing tooling. Contribute to platform governance, including access controls, auditability, and operational standards. Provide technical leadership, set platform standards, and mentor engineers contributing to the analytics platform. Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-related outages. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field with 5+ years of pl atform or platform engineering experience. Strong experience with Snowflake, MicroStrategy and Tableau platform administrative management & support. Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar. Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Experience managing and supporting analytics platforms such as Airflow, Datameer and Tableau. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes. Experience with scripting languages such as PySpark, Python, Bash, or similar. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.). Understanding of networking, security, and cloud architecture principles. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies in a changing environment Experience working in evolving platform ecosystems where tools and priorities shift over time Preferred Qualifications Experience with data platform ecosystems and integration with data warehouse s like Snowflake or Redshift . Experience evaluating and introducing new tools or platforms into production environments Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. Experience implementing Platform practices for BI and analytics tools, especially MicroStrategy and Tableau. Knowledge of Datameer platform administration, optimization, and troubleshooting. Experience with secrets management tools (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault). Experience implementing security and compliance frameworks in cloud environments. Familiarity with cost optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure. Experience working in retail, e-commerce, or consumer-facing environments. Exposure to AI/ML platform deployment and MLOps practices. What You Get Enjoy a rewarding career at Catalyst, where we offer a competitive benefits package, a vibrant work environment, and the opportunity to make a difference with America's most iconic retail brands. Generous benefits: Medical/dental/vision insurance starting on day one, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays, 401(k) Savings Plan with company match, and an associate discount on merchandise across all Catalyst Brands. Opportunities for growth and development: We are committed to helping our employees grow their careers and develop their skills. We offer a variety of training and development programs, as well as opportunities for advancement. Collaborative and supportive culture: We believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage teamwork and collaboration, and we are always looking for ways to support our employees' success. About Catalyst Catalyst Brands reflects the bringing together the rich heritages of our brands with modern excitement and a new vision for success. Five iconic brands came together under a unified powerhouse portfolio to celebrate the essence of American style. We will leverage our rich history, resources and best-in-class industry talent to further build the success of our brands. At Catalyst we are united in one shared purpose: We exist to ignite America’s most beloved retail brands to make fashion accessible to all. For more opportunities to join our team please visit our careers page. Pay Range USD $103,500.00 - USD $172,500.00 /Yr.

new_matches.description: Všade bezpečne Voľné pozície O nás Benefity Špecialista kybernetickej bezpečnosti (m/ž) Miesto práce Domkárska 9, Bratislava Druh pracovného pomeru plný úväzok Termín nástupu dohodou Mzdové podmienky (brutto) 2 043 EUR/mesiacCelková odmena pozostáva zo základnej mzdy, prípadného osobného ohodnotenia a ďalších peňažných a nepeňažných plnení poskytovaných v súlade s kolektívnou zmluvou, internými smernicami a individuálnymi podmienkami dohodnutými v pracovnej zmluve. Informácie o pracovnom mieste Náplň práce, právomoci a zodpovednosti Hľadáme skúseného kolegu / kolegyňu v oblasti kybernetickej bezpečnosti, ktorý/á sa chce podieľať na ochrane informačných systémov, identifikácii bezpečnostných rizík a budovaní odolného IT prostredia. Ak vás baví práca s modernými bezpečnostnými technológiami, riešenie technických výziev a neustále zlepšovanie bezpečnostných procesov, radi vás privítame v našom tíme. Vašou Úlohou Bude Implementácia a kontrola bezpečnostných opatrení v systéme riadenia informačnej a kybernetickej bezpečnosti. Monitorovanie, vyhodnocovanie a riešenie bezpečnostných udalostí a kybernetických bezpečnostných incidentov. Kontrola dodržiavania interných bezpečnostných predpisov, politík a legislatívnych požiadaviek v oblasti kybernetickej bezpečnosti. Identifikácia, analýza a monitorovanie bezpečnostných rizík vrátane návrhu preventívnych a nápravných opatrení. Tvorba, aktualizácia a správa bezpečnostnej dokumentácie, metodik, smerníc a politik. Posudzovanie projektov, zmien a nových riešení z pohľadu informačnej a kybernetickej bezpečnosti. Návrh a rozvoj bezpečnostných opatrení a technických riešení na ochranu informačných systémov, sietí a technologickej infraštruktúry. Spolupráca pri implementácii a prevádzke bezpečnostných nástrojov a systémov monitorovania bezpečnosti. Komunikácia s národnými autoritami a spolupráca pri hlásení a riešení kybernetických bezpečnostných incidentov. Poskytovanie odborných konzultácii a metodickej podpory vlastníkom aktív, správcom systémov, projektovým tímom a dodávateľom. Realizácia vzdelávacích aktivít a školení v oblasti informačnej a kybernetickej bezpečnosti. Spolupráca pri auditoch, kontrolách, verejných obstarávaniach a ďalších aktivitách súvisiacich s informačnou a kybernetickou bezpečnosťou. Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity Benefity, ktoré vám uľahčia prácu a spríjemnia život. V NDS vieme, že spokojní zamestnanci sú základom úspechu. Preto vám ponúkame nielen stabilné pracovné prostredie, ale aj množstvo výhod, ktoré podporia váš profesionálny aj osobný rozvoj. Od finančných benefitov, až po starostlivosť o vašu pohodu – u nás nájdete viac než len prácu. Pozrite sa, čo všetko vás u nás čaká! ⬇️ 7,5 hodinový pracovný úväzok – vďaka tomu majú naši zamestnanci v prepočte o 16 dní v roku viac voľna, Oddych je dôležitý. S nami si užijete až 5 dní dovolenky naviac, 3 dni mesačne môžete u nás pracovať formou home-office, MultiSport karta, Príspevok na stravovanie vo výške 150€, Príspevok na III. pilier DDS vo výške 420€ za rok – myslíme na vašu budúcnosť, Finančná odmena pri pracovných výročiach – vážime si vernosť a lojalitu, Jedinečný príspevok na ročnú diaľničnú známku v hodnote 70€, Odmeňujeme darcov krvi až do výšky 80€ ročne, Príspevok pri narodení dieťaťa vo výške 250€ - mať rodinu je dôležité, podporíme vás, Poskytujeme pracovné voľno s náhradou mzdy v trvaní jeden deň za rok na účasť na dobrovoľníckej aktivite, Myslíme sociálne, v nepriaznivých životných situáciách podávame pomocnú ruku, Ak zostanete PN, finančne vás podporíme, Zamestnanci u nás odborne aj ľudsky rastú, podporujeme rozvoj a vzdelávanie, organizujeme rôzne kurzy a školenia, Sme „Zdravá firma“, zdravie je pre nás na 1. mieste a pre našich kolegov ponúkame množstvo aktivít zameraných na posilnenie zdravia, „Self-help zóna“ - myslíme na duševné zdravie našich zamestnancov, Možnosť využívať vlastné rekreačné zariadenie pre zamestnancov a rodinných príslušníkov v Liptovskom Jáne za zvýhodnené ceny. Informácie o výberovom konaní Oslovila Vás naša ponuka? Dajte nám o sebe čo najskôr vedieť prostredníctvom svojho životopisu. Motivačný alebo sprievodný list poteší, radi sa o Vás dozvieme čo najviac. V Národnej diaľničnej spoločnosti si vážime všetky reakcie na naše pracovné ponuky a s výsledkom výberového konania kontaktujeme každého uchádzača. To tiež znamená, že ak niekoho na pohovor nevyberieme, môžeme sa mu znova ozvať neskôr s ponukou pozície, ktorá oveľa viac vyhovuje jeho skúsenostiam alebo schopnostiam. Preto, ak Vás v budúcnosti u nás zaujme iná ponuka, určite neváhajte poslať žiadosť opätovne. My sa jej vždy budeme dôkladne venovať. Požiadavky na zamestnanca Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním vysokoškolské II. stupňa vysokoškolské III. stupňa Ostatné znalosti Microsoft Word - Pokročilý Microsoft Excel - Mierne pokročilý Microsoft PowerPoint - Pokročilý Microsoft Outlook - Pokročilý Vodičský preukaz B Prax na pozícii/v oblasti minimálne 2 roky praxe v oblasti informačných technológií, z toho najmenej 1 rok praxe v oblasti riadenia IT služieb, riadenia informačnej bezpečnosti, riadenia rizík alebo architektúry IT Počet rokov praxe 2 Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti Ideálny Kandidát/ka Spĺňa Nasledujúce Predpoklady prax zameraná najmä na implementáciu, prevádzku a kontrolu bezpečnostných opatrení v prostredí sietí a informačných systémov, skúsenosti s FortiGate NG Firewall, FortiAnalyzer - výhodou, znalosti sieťových technológii, znalosti sieťových protokolov (SSL, HTTP, DNS, DHCP, IPSec), skúsenosti so SIEM - výhodou, znalosť LAN/WAN, Security na pokročilej úrovni - výhodou, silné komunikačné a prezentačné zručnosti, tímová spolupráca naprieč organizačnými útvarmi, schopnosť odborných konzultácií, analytické a koncepčné myslenie, samostatnosť, zodpovednosť, systematický prístup, rozhodnosť a orientácia na výsledok, profesionalita, integrita, schopnosť pracovať pod tlakom a proaktívny prístup k riešeniu úloh a ďalšiemu rozvoju, ochota cestovať na služobné cesty v rámci Slovenska a v prípade potreby aj do zahraničia. Uchádzač musí spĺňať požiadavky pre vedomosti a zručnosti v súlade s prílohou č. 4 Vyhlášky Národného bezpečnostného úradu č. 492/2022 Z. z., ktorou sa ustanovujú znalostné štandardy v oblasti kybernetickej bezpečnosti. Znalosť platnej legislatívy SR a EÚ v oblasti informačnej a kybernetickej bezpečnosti, najmä zákona č. 69/2018 Z. z. o kybernetickej bezpečnosti a príslušných vykonávacích vyhlášok. Znalosť medzinárodných štandardov v oblasti informačnej a kybernetickej bezpečnosti, najmä štandardov radu ISO/IEC 27000, Výhodou je znalosť špecifík OT prostredia (SCADA, PLC, riadiace systémy) a ochrany kritickej infraštruktúry. Certifikácie (napr. Security+, CEH, ISO/IEC 27001 alebo iné relevantné bezpečnostné certifikácie) sú výhodou. Držba platného profesijného certifikátu vydaného organizáciou ISC2 alebo iného s pracovnou pozíciou súvisiaceho platného odborného certifikátu vydaného organizáciou ISACA sa považuje za preukázanie časti odbornej spôsobilosti. Certifikát musí byť platný ku dňu obsadzovania pracovnej pozície a jeho platnosť musí trvať minimálne 6 mesiacov odo dňa obsadenia pracovného miesta. Prijatý uchádzač musí absolvovať bezpečnostnú previerku 1.stupňa - stupeň utajenia Vyhradené. Inzerujúca spoločnosť Stručná charakteristika spoločnosti Národná diaľničná spoločnosť vznikla v roku 2005 a jej 100% akcionárom je štát. Zamestnáva viac ako 2 000 ľudí. Úlohou spoločnosti je napĺňať ciele Programu prípravy a výstavby diaľnic, ktorý schvaľuje Vláda Slovenskej republiky. Zabezpečuje niekoľko veľmi významných a štátom regulovaných činností, predovšetkým plánovanie, prípravu a výstavbu diaľnic, ich údržbu a realizáciu opráv. V spolupráci s prevádzkovateľom mýtneho systému zabezpečuje spoplatnenie cestnej infraštruktúry v SR. Pridanou hodnotou služieb, ktoré strediská vykonávajú je bezplatná služba pre motoristov Diaľničná patrola. Svojou činnosťou zvyšuje úroveň bezpečnosti cestnej premávky a zabezpečuje náležitý komfort cestujúcej verejnosti.
