new_matches.description: The position is described below. If you want to apply, click the Apply Now button at the top or bottom of this page. After you click Apply Now and complete your application, you'll be invited to create a profile, which will let you see your application status and any communications. If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status. Need Help? If you have a disability and need assistance with the application, you can request a reasonable accommodation. Send an email to Accessibility (accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response). Regular or Temporary: Regular Language Fluency: English (Required) Work Shift: 1st shift (United States of America) Please review the following job description: The Senior Network Automation and Tool Integration Engineer designs and delivers secure, end-to-end automation across enterprise network, observability, IT service management, and DevOps platforms. This role connects existing workflows in Python and Ansible automation with GitLab Duo, Ansible Automation Platform, Cisco SD-WAN controllers, Catalyst Center, Splunk Cloud, OpenText NNMi, ServiceNow, and ThousandEyes. The engineer develops reusable Python services, REST API integrations, Ansible workflows, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines that convert manual processes and standalone scripts into scalable, governed automation services. Responsibilities include automated provisioning, configuration validation, incident enrichment, compliance checks, event correlation, change execution, post-change validation, and closed-loop remediation. The ideal candidate has strong Python, API, Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, and enterprise integration experience, combined with practical knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, telemetry, and network operations. The candidate should also be able to containerize Python APIs and lightweight front-end applications and deploy them to an enterprise container platform or UI for simple user experience. This role collaborates with network engineering, operations, platform, cybersecurity, and ITSM teams to establish reusable integration patterns, improve operational efficiency, strengthen automation governance, and deliver observable, auditable, production-ready solutions. For this opportunity: Truist will not sponsor an applicant for work visa status or employment authorization, nor will we offer any immigration-related support for this position (including, but not limited to H-1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN-1 or TN-2, E-3, O-1, or future sponsorship for U.S. lawful permanent residence status.) *** Role is NOT remote *** *** In office expectations are 5 days per week. *** Essential Duties And Responsibilities Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. Designs, builds, and implements enterprise infrastructure technology platforms and systems across cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, or middleware domains. Applies automation, monitoring, and optimization techniques to ensure high availability and performance of infrastructure. Manages infrastructure engineering projects and processes aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to integrate new technologies and continuously improve infrastructure standards and processes. Troubleshoots and resolves complex technical issues impacting infrastructure performance and reliability. Supports compliance with technology strategies, standards, and governance to mitigate risks and ensure regulatory adherence. Reviews and guides infrastructure designs, configurations, and procedures to support operational consistency and knowledge sharing. Provides technical guidance and direction to lower-level technical professionals. Develops technical solutions with deep analysis of infrastructure systems and leads infrastructure processes. Qualifications Required Qualifications The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering. Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies including cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, and middleware. Preferred Qualifications Strong knowledge and experience in software development and technical designs and implementation. Proven experience managing IT infrastructure projects. Proficiency in GitLab CI/CD pipeline authoring, including multi-stage pipelines, runners, environments, and security scanning integration. Working knowledge of Ansible , SON, YAML and Ansible Automation Platform, including playbook authoring, inventory management, and AAP workflow templates. Experience with OPA (Open Policy Agent) and policy-as-code patterns in pipeline enforcement contexts. Infrastructure-as-code competency in Terraform or equivalent, with demonstrated deployment experience in Azure and/or AWS environments, Hosted appsv. Python/Flask and/or scripting proficiency sufficient to build integration glue, automate workflows, and produce production-grade tooling in short iteration cycles. Experience working in a regulated financial services, healthcare, or government environment where compliance constraints directly shape technical architecture decisions. Operates with high ownership and can make meaningful progress without fully defined requirements. Communicates technical complexity in plain language and can effectively engage both executive and technical audiences. Comfortable operating in environments that include legacy technologies, ongoing modernization efforts, and emerging capabilities. Expertise and Skills in Areas Mentioned Below: APIs - REST, Webhooks ITSM - ServiceNow APIs Observability - Splunk, ThousandEyes, SNMP traps Networking - Catalyst Center APIs, vManage APIs, Meraki Integration - Event-driven architecture General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation: All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site. Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non-temporary position for which you apply, based on full-time or part-time status, position, and division of work. new_matches.title: ERP System Administrator (Deltek Vantagepoint)
new_matches.description: Ardurra is looking to hire an ERP System Administrator (Deltek Vantagepoint) to join our Information Technology team. This position is open to remote or hybrid applicants. Ardurra is a multidisciplinary civil engineering services firm which provides broad-based solutions tailored to the specific needs of the public and private sector. We leverage the depth of our professional and technical expertise, as well as our integrated structure, to deliver practical, innovative solutions for our clients. We have been creating opportunities for our employees to develop both personally and professionally. As a result, our team has contributed to some of the nation’s most important infrastructure projects. These are projects that can positively impact people’s lives. Position Summary The ERP System Administrator is responsible for managing, supporting, and optimizing the company's ERP system. This role involves maintaining the Deltek Vantagepoint system, troubleshooting issues, providing user support, and implementing system upgrades and enhancements. The ERP System Administrator will work closely with the shared services teams and other stakeholders to ensure the system meets organizational needs and drives efficiency. Key Responsibilities System Administration: Manage and maintain the company’s ERP System (Deltek Vantagepoint) ensuring optimal performance and availability. User Support: Provide technical support and training to end-users, addressing queries and resolving system-related issues promptly. Data Management: Oversee data integrity and accuracy, ensuring proper data flow and consistency. Data Migration: Assist and support in the migration of acquisition data. System Enhancements: Collaborate with stakeholders to identify system enhancement opportunities and assist in the implementation of new features and tools. Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve system issues, working with technical teams as necessary to ensure minimal disruption to operations. Documentation: Create and maintain documentation for system processes, user guides, and troubleshooting procedures to support end-users effectively. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Minimum 3 years of experience with Deltek Vantagepoint or Deltek Vision. Advanced expertise of accounting processes and procedures. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with various levels of the organization. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. Preferred Qualifications Expertise in Microsoft SQL Server (queries, stored procedures, performance tuning). Familiarity with financial reporting tools and methodologies, or Corporate Accounting processes in a professional services environment. Background in professional services, architecture/engineering, or construction industries. Competencies Accountability Adaptability Communication Planning & Organization Personal Development Why Ardurra? While Ardurra offers competitive compensation and rich benefits programs, it is our culture that truly sets us apart from our peers. We nurture a family-like culture, striving to create a work environment that is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding but also fun. We are acutely focused on developing our staff, whether through our internal Ardurra Academy or through our industry-leading Leadership program. We have made a deliberate and focused commitment to nurture a people-centric culture where people are: valued as individuals; supported in their professional and career development with multiple, varied career paths; provided the tools and resources to be successful, engaged, and satisfied in their work; and positive benefits, time-off programs, and flexibility to help maintain a healthy balance between work and home. Ardurra is an Equal Opportunity/ Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation. Notice To Third Party Agencies Ardurra does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Agency Agreement, Ardurra will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. If a resume or candidate is submitted to any hiring manager without a previously signed agreement, Ardurra reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. new_matches.description: Description Classification: Exempt Compensation Range: $75k-$85k Location: Austin, TX Work Type: Hybrid Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm CT Reports To: Head of Technology Company Description For years, most people didn’t understand risk, insurance, or the policies themselves. Yet, back in 1969, a small group of Texas independent agents knew the truth: with a structured curriculum and practical, real-life education beyond theory, they could ignite an entire industry of skilled professionals. Together with University of Texas educators, these pioneering agents formed the industry’s first nonprofit training and CE credit resource. Along the way, we’ve built a genuine community of professionals who succeed and thrive. For decades, we’ve impacted millions of professionals with our practical education. Like us, they’re dedicated to lifelong learning and collaboration. Our participants understand their career potential and gain a real workplace advantage. Today, our education and networks continue to evolve and expand. We are trusted to lead the risk management and insurance industry through change. The Risk & Insurance Education Alliance ensures no one must go it alone. We’ve made success a group activity. Mission We are committed to creating professionals through practical education and technical guidance to lead the risk management and insurance industry of the future, for the common good. Vision Empowering a confident, professional community to shape tomorrow's risk and insurance industry. These qualities commit us to act responsibly, to be accountable for our actions, to fulfil our obligations, and to inspire others with our relentless determination to achieve a standard of excellence in every endeavor. Our Benefits 17 Paid Holidays- Closed the week between Christmas Eve and New Years Day Medical, Dental Vision, & Supplemental Insurance Flexible Spending Account & Health Savings Account Employee Assistance Program Company Paid Long Term Disability Company Paid Life Insurance Vacation, Sick, Birthday, & Volunteering Paid Time Off 401K- 4.5% Match Paid Parental Leave Employee Referral Program Book Club Company Happy Hours Position Description The Cloud and Cybersecurity Technician is a senior technical role responsible for safeguarding the organization's cloud environments, digital assets, and information systems through the implementation of security controls, monitoring, risk management, and compliance initiatives. The role serves as a primary contributor to cloud security architecture, cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, threat detection and response, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance efforts, while partnering with IT and business stakeholders to support secure technology adoption across the organization. This position plays a key role in executing cybersecurity strategy, strengthening the organization's security posture, responding to incidents, and advancing cloud security and governance initiatives. While the role does not define enterprise technology strategy, it is responsible for implementing and maintaining approved security architectures, controls, policies, and operational practices that protect organizational systems, data, and services. The Cloud and Cybersecurity Technician also provides technical leadership in security-focused projects, continuous monitoring, risk remediation, and compliance validation to ensure a resilient and secure technology environment. Requirements Responsibilities: Security & Compliance (Execution & Operations) Support execution of the organization’s security framework through tooling, configuration, and operational follow-through. Perform alert monitoring and initial incident triage, escalating to leadership or vendors as appropriate. Maintain operational ownership of incident response, including coordination, remediation execution, and documentation. Assist with vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation efforts across infrastructure, platforms, and vendors. Support user security awareness and risk training initiatives developed by leadership. Assist with audit preparation and compliance validation, including evidence collection and remediation tracking. Vendor & Project Coordination Coordinate with external vendors and managed service providers to support infrastructure, security, and platform operations. Escalate incidents and technical issues to vendors as required and track resolution through closure. Support technology projects by executing technical tasks, validating changes, and ensuring operational readiness. Participate in change management workflows, ensuring infrastructure and security changes follow approved processes. IT Operations & Cross-Role Support Provide Tier 2–3 technical support for infrastructure, network, and platform-level issues. Assist the Senior Systems Administrator and/or Systems Support/Helpdesk (L1) role during periods of increased demand or complex operational work. Support onboarding and offboarding workflows as needed to ensure access, systems, and infrastructure readiness. Participate in requirements gathering and customer-facing analysis for infrastructure and platform initiatives. Quality, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Perform structured QA and regression testing for infrastructure, network, and platform changes. Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and SOPs for supported systems. Identify infrastructure risks, technical debt, and improvement opportunities and escalate recommendations appropriately. Contribute operational insight to architecture governance and optimization efforts. Business & Stakeholder Support Support requirements gathering and internal customer analysis for IT initiatives. Translate business needs into technical tasks and implementation steps. Act as a trusted operational IT partner to internal teams, balancing usability, stability, and risk. Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer-service skills, with the ability to support users of varying technical ability while adapting quickly to new technologies and processes. Other Duties As Assigned Other duties as assigned to support organizational goals. Day In The Life (DITL) The day-to-day work of this role is structured around infrastructure reliability, cloud and network administration, security operations execution, and audit readiness. The role is infrastructure-heavy, while maintaining the flexibility to support IT operations and learning platforms as priorities require. Daily Activities Review infrastructure, network, and security monitoring; evaluate alerts and perform initial triage. Execute incident response actions for infrastructure or security events, including remediation, documentation, and escalation when needed. Work through security controls audits on a quarterly basis following the audit SOP Resolve Tier 2–3 infrastructure, network, and security cases, maintaining documentation suitable for audit trails. Provide targeted support to IT Operations or learning platforms during escalations, events, or high-impact issues. Weekly Activities Participate in infrastructure and security check-ins to review incidents, open risks, and planned changes. Conduct routine network administration and security governance activities, including configuration reviews and access validation. Coordinate with vendors and service providers on infrastructure, security, and remediation work, tracking progress through resolution. Execute QA and regression validation for infrastructure, network, and security changes. Monthly/Ongoing Activities Support upcoming security framework audits by validating control implementation, producing evidence, and tracking remediation items to closure. Coordinate vulnerability assessment follow-up and remediation across infrastructure, cloud, and network environments. Review infrastructure and network architecture for configuration drift, risk, and optimization opportunities. Maintain and update infrastructure documentation, runbooks, diagrams, and operational procedures. Support learning platform stability and upgrades during launches, changes, or peak usage periods. Operating Expectations Work is planned, tracked, and visible through established case and task management systems. Capacity planning is respected — ad hoc work is balanced against roadmap commitments. Incidents, changes, and improvements follow defined workflows. Clear communication and documentation are considered part of the work, not optional overhead. Ongoing Learning & Professional Development Expectations This role requires a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth in order to remain effective as technologies, security practices, and operational standards evolve. The Employee Is Expected To Proactively maintain and expand technical knowledge relevant to the role, including infrastructure, cloud services, security practices, and supported platforms. Stay current with updates, changes, and best practices related to tools, systems, and frameworks used by the organization. Participate in required training, certifications, or skill-development activities as identified by leadership or organizational needs. Apply new knowledge to improve operational effectiveness, reliability, security posture, and user experience. Seek opportunities for self-improvement that align with the organization’s technology roadmap and evolving priorities. Ongoing learning is considered a core responsibility of the role, not a one-time activity, and supports both individual success and the long-term resilience of the technology organization. Required Education & Experience 5+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure. 2+ Years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure and Management. 2+ Years of experience in Web application support. Experience supporting audits, compliance validation and regulatory requirement reviews. Proven background in delivering excellent customer service. Meraki experience with network infrastructure. Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills. Ability to work within defined governance and escalation structures. Vendor and 3rd party alignment. Technology project scope, deployment and support experience. Supervisor Responsibilities This position does not supervise any employees. Work Environment This position is hybrid and can be performed from our climate-controlled office, with normal office noise. It may also be performed from a location of your choosing, in the city and state you were hired in. Physical & Position Demands The physical demands of this job include sitting in a stationary position in an office environment. Home office set up is highly encouraged and the company will provide the necessary tools to ensure you have an effective and comfortable workspace. The Risk & Insurance Education Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

new_matches.title: Staff IT Engineer
new_matches.description: About Abridge Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients. Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. The Role As a Staff IT Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for driving efficiency and scale across the entire corporate IT infrastructure and enterprise ecosystem. You will design, build, and maintain mission-critical automation solutions that eliminate manual processes, enhance security posture, and improve the employee experience globally. This role requires deep engineering expertise, an IT product mindset for automation, and the ability to mentor junior team members while tackling the organization's most complex integration and scaling challenges. You will work directly with IT leadership, Security leadership, and department heads across the company. Operating at the intersection of healthcare AI and enterprise IT, you will be expected to architect and enforce automation standards that meet the rigorous demands of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-audited environment. What You'll Do Workflow Automation: Develop scalable, resilient workflow automation solutions to streamline critical business processes, including onboarding/offboarding, access requests, compliance enforcement, and self-service IT support. API and Integration Development: Serve as the subject matter expert for integrating disparate systems by building robust, fault-tolerant connections using APIs and event-driven architectures. Identity and Access Management (IAM): Drive automation within the IAM infrastructure, focusing on automated role assignment, least-privilege policy enforcement, and audit-friendly logging of authentication and authorization events. Enterprise Data Engineering: Architect and engineer robust data platforms for IT, ensuring efficient collection, normalization, and secure storage of high-volume enterprise data for reporting, audit, and advanced analytics. Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier for the team — establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, documenting architectures, and mentoring engineers in automation principles. Business Systems & Custom Application Deployment: Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of business-critical systems and custom-built applications, from architecture and vendor evaluation through implementation, integration, and ongoing support — ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise IT standards. What You'll Need Experience: 10+ years in IT Engineering, IT Apps Development, or DevOps, with at least 5 years dedicated to large-scale enterprise automation. Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience automating complex operations and governance across GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. You will bring an ability to build and modularize infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (i.e. Terraform). Programming Proficiency: Highly proficient in at least one modern programming language; strong preference for Python. Systems Integration: Proven experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and querying and managing relational databases (SQL strongly preferred). Automation Platforms: Extensive experience designing and managing centralized automation platforms (e.g., n8n, SOAR, Ansible, Workato, or custom frameworks). Compliance Context: Experience operating in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with exposure to SOC 2, HIPAA, or equivalent compliance frameworks. Communication: Able to communicate effectively across a wide range of audiences — from engineers to GTM stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives. Bonus Points Experience with agentic AI or ML models applied to IT automation (proactive issue detection, intelligent routing, NLP). Why Work at Abridge? At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month. Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business. Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you. How we take care of Abridgers: Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families. Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA. Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees. Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family. 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future. Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage. Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits. Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more. Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals. Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment. Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees. ... and much more! Equal Opportunity Employer Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process. Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions. Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

new_matches.title: Cloud Engineer
new_matches.description: Job Description Everforth ECS is seeking a Cloud Engineer to work in our Quantico, VA office. ECS is seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer (Mid) to support cutting-edge technology for law enforcement and scientific organizations. The Cloud Engineer will be responsible for the design, deployment, configuration, security, monitoring, and maintenance of AWS cloud infrastructure and cloud-native services supporting mission-critical applications and data systems. We are seeking a creative problem solver who enjoys tackling complex cloud engineering challenges with minimal oversight, enabling scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments. The ideal candidate has strong AWS experience and a deep understanding of cloud architecture principles, security best practices, automation, and operational excellence. A strong desire and aptitude for learning is required, along with the ability to adapt and drive change in an environment with evolving requirements, technologies, and security threats. This individual will be integral to supporting secure data operations, system reliability, and infrastructure modernization efforts across diverse client environments. Responsibilities of the Cloud Engineer include but are not limited to: Design, deploy, configure, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as CloudFormation or Terraform. Architect and support highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable AWS environments aligned with AWS Well-Architected Framework best practices. Configure and manage core AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudWatch, and related services. Support multi-environment (Dev, Test, Prod) cloud deployments while ensuring configuration consistency and security compliance. Implement and manage networking components including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, NAT gateways, and load balancers. Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and cost utilization using CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config, and related tools. Support patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management of cloud-hosted systems and operating systems (Linux-based preferred). Implement security best practices including least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and logging/auditing controls. Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, networking, and system-level issues in AWS environments. Collaborate with DevOps, security, engineering, and data teams to support application deployment and operational stability. Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements for infrastructure reliability, cost optimization, and security posture. Salary Range: $150,000 - $180,000 General Description Of Benefits Required Skills US Citizenship and active Top-Secret Clearance. 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure. Strong experience with AWS core services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail. 5+ years of experience using Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation or Terraform). Strong understanding of AWS networking (VPC architecture, subnets, routing, security groups, NACLs, NAT gateways). 5+ years of Linux system administration experience; comfort navigating and troubleshooting Linux environments. new_matches.description: About The Role As a Security Engineer at K Health, you will serve as a foundational force in securing our healthcare technology ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Director of Security, this is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role focused primarily on Security Operations (SecOps) and IT Security projects. You will be responsible for building, automating, and maintaining our security controls while acting as a key responder to security incidents. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you are empowered to own your domain, automate repetitive tasks, and directly safeguard patient and organizational data, this role is for you. What You Will Do Design, implement, and maintain hands-on SecOps workflows, threat detection, and incident response procedures across our corporate and cloud infrastructure. Build low-code and custom automations (using tools like Torq) to streamline security alerts, routine IT security tasks, and incident triage. Administer, optimize, and manage key security and endpoint management tools, including Sumo Logic, Jamf, Intune, Slack Enterprise, CrowdStrike, and related platforms. Maintain and support continuous compliance with SOC2 and HIPAA security controls, actively participating in audit preparation, evidence gathering, and control enforcement. Partner with cross-functional IT and engineering teams to harden systems, enforce zero-trust endpoint policies, and secure employee workflows. Conduct root-cause analysis on security incidents and proactively implement preventative security measures to eliminate recurring risks. What We Are Looking For Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated hands-on experience in Security Operations, IT Security, or System Administration with a strong security focus. Incident Response: Proven background in actively detecting, investigating, and remediating security incidents in a modern cloud/hybrid environment. Technical Depth: Deep foundational IT background spanning endpoint administration (macOS/Windows), identity management, and network security. Compliance Standards: Demonstrated experience maintaining controls for SOC2 and/or HIPAA frameworks in an operational setting. Automation Mindset: Hands-on experience automating security operations or IT tasks using SOAR platforms, scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash), or API integrations. Bonus Direct experience implementing SOC2 or HIPAA controls from scratch or directly interfacing with external auditors. Hands-on familiarity with our specific technology stack: Sumo Logic, Jamf, Intune, Slack Enterprise, CrowdStrike, and Torq. Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Security+, Network+, GIAC, or vendor-specific platform certifications).
